products.title: Golden Retrievers Mascot Medallion — Tee
products.description:
The dog head-on and filling the frame, sticks crossed behind, inside a single heavy gold ring. The most drawing of any mark in the set, and the one that most wants room.

Bella+Canvas 3001: 4.2 oz combed ringspun cotton, 32 singles, side-seamed, shoulder-taped, unisex sizing. Printed direct-to-garment by Printful, front only. The print is a proportion of the garment, so it grows with it — eight inches across on a small, eleven on a 3XL.

White, ash and athletic heather. Black, navy, heather navy and dark grey heather. The medallion is black inside the ring, and the ring is what holds it on a dark body.

Buffalo, N.Y. Playing since {{firstYear}}.

products.title: Golden Retrievers Crossed Shield — Tee
products.description:

Bella+Canvas 3001: 4.2 oz combed ringspun cotton, 32 singles, side-seamed, shoulder-taped, unisex sizing. Printed direct-to-garment by Printful, front only. The print is a proportion of the garment, so it grows with it — eight inches across on a small, eleven on a 3XL.

White, ash and athletic heather. Black, navy, heather navy and dark grey heather. The most open drawing in the set — the sticks, the banners and the dog all sit proud of the shield, so it holds together on either body.

Buffalo, N.Y. Playing since {{firstYear}}.

products.title: Golden Retrievers Rink Board — Hoodie
products.description:
The name the way it would be painted on the boards: a long gold-edged bar, the dog in a roundel at the left, a stick and a puck running out to the right.

Independent Trading Co. IND4000: 10 oz of 80/20 cotton-polyester heavyweight fleece, jersey-lined hood, twill-taped neck, ribbed cuffs and hem, front pouch. The front panel is wider than it is tall, so a square mark is limited by height here and a wide one is not; the back panel is the largest canvas anything in this shop is printed on.

White. Black and navy. The board is black inside a gold edge. On a dark body the edge is what you see and the board becomes the garment.

Buffalo, N.Y. Playing since {{firstYear}}.

products.title: Golden Retrievers Heritage Seal — Sticker
products.description:
A double gold ring with GOLDEN arched over the top and RETRIEVERS around the foot, the dog in three-quarter profile over crossed sticks. Drawn as a seal, so it wants to be round and it wants an edge.

UV printed on white vinyl, kiss-cut, rated for outdoor use. It will outlast at least two of the platforms this team's record had to be recovered from. Sold in threes — one sticker costs more to post than to make, and three cost the same to post as one.

Three inches or four, and the three in a set can be three different marks.

sale.why: One sticker costs more to post ($4.59) than to make ($2.00), and free shipping on one would need an $11 price tag. Three post for $4.77. The three are three STICKERS and not three of one design: every sticker here is the same blueprint through the same maker, so postage merges across the designs as readily as across copies of one.
